bibliography.corrections: complete the entry from the chart: title 'Lower Hot Brook Lake'; place line 'Bancroft, Danforth, T8 R4 NBPP, Washington Co.'; one-page depth chart with 10-ft and 2.5-ft contours; 'Data source: Maine IFW - Historic'; basemap 'electronic USGS topographic data with minor revisions by MDIFW'.
